faqs.question: How can I check my attendance?
faqs.answer: Open the Attendance page from the sidebar to view your subject-wise attendance.

faqs.question: Where can I see my examination schedule?
faqs.answer: You can find your examination schedule on the Exams page.

faqs.question: How can I check my results?
faqs.answer: Open the Results page from the Student Hub sidebar to view your examination results.

faqs.question: Where can I find upcoming events?
faqs.answer: Open the Events page to view upcoming technical, cultural and sports events.

faqs.question: How can I change my password?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings, enter your new password and confirm it before selecting Save Changes.

faqs.question: How can I update my profile?
faqs.answer: Open the Profile page and select the edit option to update your profile information.

faqs.question: Where can I see important notices?
faqs.answer: Important academic and campus announcements are available on the Notices section.

faqs.question: Who should I contact for technical problems?
faqs.answer: You can contact the Student Hub administrator through the Contact page.
